items.title: Nemetschek falls 5% as J.P. Morgan flags weaker growth outlook
items.summary: Investing.com -- Nemetschek SE (ETR:NEKG) shares were down as much as 8.8% on Monday before paring losses to trade down 5.7%, after J.P. Morgan cut the stock to “underweight” from “overweight,” saying it expects consensus organic growth forecasts to be lowered.
